Image 3 is a finished background painting from our game: use it ONLY as the reference for the painting technique (brushwork, palette, edge softness, level of detail, line quality); do not copy anything from its scene.

Place: the inside of a small single-storey 1970s service building at the edge of the ZŠ Sokolíkova school grounds in Dúbravka, Bratislava, between the kindergarten and the housing-estate blocks: an invented issue room for school maintenance material, run by the local maintenance operation. Image 2 shows the panel blocks of this estate (white-grey concrete, red balcony parapets): the window of the room looks out at the end of such a block across the snowy courtyard.

Early December 1982, a grey winter afternoon: cool daylight from the window, warm light from the two fluorescent tubes, a cosy, orderly, slightly worn workplace.

Keep this exact geometry from the sketch: the back wall meets the floor at y 740 and meets the ceiling at y 200; the ceiling with two fluorescent tube fittings is visible above; the wooden issue counter stands in the room in front of the shelves from x 400 to x 1300, its front face standing on the floor at y 805 and its top front edge one straight horizontal line at y 597; the floor in front of the counter runs to the bottom edge.
